ਸਮਾਈ।","translit_en":"pa(n)cham vich aakaas kar karataa chhaTam adhisaT samaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fifth element sky (void) was kept in between and creator God, the sixth one, invisibly files.shabads/80/40003.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40003,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":1,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":200018,"last_verse_id":200026,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":200018,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੩ : ਮਨੁੱਖ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਉੱਤਮਤਾ","translit_en":"pauRee 3 : manu'kh janam dhee u'tamataa","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Grandeur of human birth"}}},{"verse_id":200019,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਲਖ ਜੋਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸਿ ਦੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"chauraaseeh lakh jon vich utam janamu su maanas dhehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Of the eighty four lacs life classes, birth as a human is the best."}}},{"verse_id":200020,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਅਖੀ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਕਰਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਭਿ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਬਚਨ ਸਨੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"akhee vekhan karan sun mukh subh bolan bachan sanehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eyes behold, ears listen to and the mouth speaks sweet words."}}},{"verse_id":200021,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਹਥੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਚਲਿ ਸਤਿਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"hathee kaar kamaavanee pairee chal satisa(n)g milehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hands earn livelihood and feet take towards the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":200022,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਮ ਦੀ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਲਣੁ ਕਾਰਿ ਕਰੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"kirat virat kar dharam dhee khaT khavaalan kaar karehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In human life alone by the rightful earning, out of one's savings, other needy ones are fed."}}},{"verse_id":200023,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਪੜ੍ਹਿ ਸਮਝਿ ਸੁਣੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"gurmukh janam sakaarathaa gurbaanee paReh samajh sunehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Man by becoming gurmukh- Guru oriented, makes his life meaningful; he reads Gurbani and makes others understand (the importance of) bani."}}},{"verse_id":200024,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਭਾਈ ਸੰਤੁਸਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਰਣਾਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਲੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਵੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"gurbhaiee sa(n)tusaT kar charanaamrit lai mukh pivehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He satisfies his companions and takes the holy water touched by their feet i.e. he inculcates complete humility."}}},{"verse_id":200025,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੀਐ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਕਰੇਹੀ।","translit_en":"pairee pavan na chhoddeeaai kalee kaal raharaas karehee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Humblytouching of the feet should not be repudiated because in the dark age, this quality is the only asset (of the human personality)."}}},{"verse_id":200026,"page_no":1,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪਿ ਤਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਰੇਹੀ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"aap tare gursikh tarehee ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"People of such a conduct will swim the world-ocean and also get along other disciples of the Guru."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40002,"next":40004}}

His mark is truth and He shines in bright effulgent flame."}}},{"verse_id":200727,"page_no":3,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਜ ਅਖਰ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"pa(n)j akhar upakaar naam samaaliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Five letters (1 Oankar) are altruists; they have in them the power of the person of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":200728,"page_no":3,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"paramesur sukh saar nadhar nihaaliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The individual, understanding their import becomes blest with graceful glance of God who is the essence of delights."}}},{"verse_id":200729,"page_no":3,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨਉ ਅੰਗਿ ਸੁੰਨ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"nau a(n)g su(n)n sumaar sa(n)g niraaliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the numerals from one to nine adding zero with them reach to the infinite count"}}},{"verse_id":200730,"page_no":3,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਨੀਲ ਅਨੀਲ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਿਆ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"neel aneel veechaar piram piaaliaa ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The persons who quaff the cup of love from their beloved become master of infinite powers."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40083,"next":40085}}

ddovanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He  grinds fresh flour (for free kitchen) and serves by fetching water."}}},{"verse_id":200756,"page_no":3,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਪਖੇ ਦੀ ਤਾਗੀਦ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ files.shabads/80/40088.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40088,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":3,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":10,"first_verse_id":200760,"last_verse_id":200769,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":200760,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੯ : ਮੁਰੀਦ ਕੀ ਕਰੇ","translit_en":"pauRee 19 : mureedh kee kare","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"What is demanded of a disciple  ?"}}},{"verse_id":200761,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਮੁਰੀਦੈ ਥੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"pairee pai paa khaak mureedhai theevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By becoming the dust of the feet the disciple is required to be near the feet of the the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":200762,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕੁ ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"gur moorat musataak mar mar jeevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becoming an avid suiter of the form (word) of the Guru and being dead to greed, infatuation and other relational propensities, he should remain alive in the world."}}},{"verse_id":200763,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਹਰਿ ਸਭੇ ਸਾਕ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"parahar sabhe saak sura(n)g ra(n)geevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Repudiating all worldly connections he must remain dyed in the colour of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":200764,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਰ ਨ ਝਖਣੁ ਝਾਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"hor na jhakhan jhaak saran man seevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeking no shelter elsewhere he should keep his mind absorbed in the shelterof God, the Guru."}}},{"verse_id":200765,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਪਾਕ ਅਮਿਅ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"piram piaalaa paak amia ras peevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sacred is the cup of the love of the beloved; he should quaff that only."}}},{"verse_id":200766,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਮਸਕੀਨੀ ਅਉਤਾਕ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਥੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"masakeenee aautaak asathir theevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Making humility his abode he should get poised in it."}}},{"verse_id":200767,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਦਸ ਅਉਰਾਤਿ ਤਲਾਕ ਸਹਜਿ ਅਲੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"dhas aauraat talaak sahaj aleevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Divorcing the (tastes of ) ten organs i.e.not being caught in their dragnet, he should attain equipose."}}},{"verse_id":200768,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕ ਨ ਮਨ ਭਰਮੀਵਣਾ।","translit_en":"saavadhaan gur vaak na man bharameevanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He must be fully conscious about the word of Guru and should not allow the mind to be entrapped in delusions."}}},{"verse_id":200769,"page_no":3,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹੁਸਨਾਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੀਵਣਾ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"sabadh surat husanaak paar pareevanaa ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Absorption of consciousness in the Word makes  him alert and this way one gets across the Word – ocean."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40087,"next":40089}}

ਮਾਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੈ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh liv haumai maar marai man dheerai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the holy  congregation, merging consciousness in the Word and eschewing ego, the  mind is tranquilized."}}},{"verse_id":200905,"page_no":4,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨ ਜਿਣਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇ ਲਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਣਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਰੀਰੈ।","translit_en":"man jin man dhe le man gun vich gun gurmukh sareerai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Conquering the mind, one should surrender it (before the Guru) and adopt the virtues of gurmukhs, the Guru oriented ones."}}},{"verse_id":200906,"page_no":4,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਰੇਣੁ ਨ ਨੀਰੈ।","translit_en":"pairee pai paa khaak hoi kaamadhen sa(n)t ren na saints."}}},{"verse_id":200907,"page_no":4,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸ ਤਰਸਨ ਸੀਰੈ।","translit_en":"silaa aloonee chaTanee lakh a(n)mirat ras tarasan seerai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This act is  nothing but licking of the tasteless stone though myriad tastes of sweet  juices one strives for."}}},{"verse_id":200908,"page_no":4,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਵਿਰਲਾ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰੈ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"viralaa sikh sunai gur peerai ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Rare is the Sikh who listens to (and accepts) the  teachings of the Guru."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40104,"next":40106}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":40106,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":4,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":200909,"last_verse_id":200916,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji ੧੭ : ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੀ ਕਰਨੀ","translit_en":"pauRee 17 : jeevan mukat dhee karanee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The conduct of the liberated one"}}},{"verse_id":200910,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੋਲਾ।","translit_en":"gur sikhee gursikh sun a(n)dhar siaanaa baahar bholaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the teachings of the Guru, the Sikh becomes wise internally though apparently he looks a simpleton."}}},{"verse_id":200911,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਬੋਲਾ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat saavadhaan hoi vin gur sabadh na suniee bolaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He with full care keeps his  consciousness attuned to the Word and listens to nothing except the words  of Guru."}}},{"verse_id":200912,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਅੰਨ੍ਹਾ ਖੋਲਾ।","translit_en":"satigur dharasan dhekhanaa saadhasa(n)gat vin a(n)nhaa kholaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He beholds the true Guru and without the company of the saints  feels himself blind and deaf."}}},{"verse_id":200913,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਲੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਚੁਪਿ ਚਬੋਲਾ।","translit_en":"vaahaguroo gur sabadh lai piram piaalaa chup chabolaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru's word he receives is Vahiguru, the  wondrous Lord, and remains silently immersed in delight."}}},{"verse_id":200914,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਚਰਣਿ ਧੋਇ ਚਰਣੋਦਕ ਝੋਲਾ।","translit_en":"pairee pai paa khaak hoi charan dhoi charanodhak jholaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He bows on the  feet and becoming (humble) like dust goes on quaffing the nectar of the feet  (of the Lord)."}}},{"verse_id":200915,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਭਵਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰੋਲਾ।","translit_en":"charan kaval chit bhavar kar bhavajal a(n)dhar rahai nirolaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He remains involved like black bee in the lotus feet (of the  Guru) and thus living in this world ocean remains unsmeared (by its water  and dust)."}}},{"verse_id":200916,"page_no":4,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਣਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਸਚਾਵਾ ਚੋਲਾ ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"jeevan mukat sachaavaa cholaa ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"His is life of a liberated one during the life on earth i.e. he is a  jivanmukt'."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40105,"next":40107}}

ਹੋਇ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਚਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਢਾਲੈ।","translit_en":"sir vich nikai vaal hoi saadhoo charan chavar kar ddaalai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Preparing the whisk of even the hair of one's head (the gurmukh) one should  wave it on the feet of the saints i.e. he should be extremely humble."}}},{"verse_id":200919,"page_no":4,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਸਰ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇ ਕੈ ਅੰਝੂ ਭਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਪੈਰਿ ਪਖਾਲੈ।","translit_en":"gur sar teerath nai kai a(n)jhoo bhar bhar pair pakhaalai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bathing  in the pilgrimage place, he should wash the feet of the Guru with tears of  love."}}},{"verse_id":200920,"page_no":4,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਲੀ ਹੂੰ ਧਉਲੇ ਕਰੇ ਚਲਣ ਜਾਣਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਮ੍ਹਾਲੈ।","translit_en":"kaalee hoo(n) dhaule kare chalan jaan neesaan samhaalai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"From black, his hair may turn grey but then considering his time to  go (from this world) he should cherish in his heart the symbol (love) of the  Lord."}}},{"verse_id":200921,"page_no":4,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਹੋਇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੈ।","translit_en":"pairee pai paa khaak hoi pooraa satigur nadhar nihaalai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When one, falling at the Guru's feet, becomes dust himself, i.e. totally deletes ego from his mind, the true Guru also then blesses and obliges  him."}}},{"verse_id":200922,"page_no":4,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਕਾਗ ਕੁਮੰਤਹੁੰ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਉਜਲ ਮੋਤੀ ਖਾਇ ਖਵਾਲੈ।","translit_en":"kaag kuma(n)tahu(n) param ha(n)s ujal motee khai khavaalai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He should become swan and leave black wisdom of crow and should  himself perform and get others perform pearl-like invaluable deeds."}}},{"verse_id":200923,"page_no":4,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਾਲੈ।","translit_en":"vaalahu nikee aakheeaai gur sikhee sun gursikh paalai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The  teachings of the Guru are subtler even than the hair itself; the Sikh should  always follow them."}}},{"verse_id":200924,"page_no":4,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਲੰਘੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"gursikh la(n)ghai piram piaalai ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikhs of the Guru go across the world-ocean by  virtue of their cup full of love."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40106,"next":40108}}

ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਲੂਅ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣੈ।","translit_en":"lakh baag brahama(n)dd vich lakh brahama(n)dd looa vich aanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Millions of  universes are there in one small hair of maanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"If that kind God showers His  grace, only then a gurmukh can enjoy the delight of the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":200931,"page_no":4,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੇ ਚਲੈ ਓਹੁ ਭਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"pairee pai paa khaak hoi saahib dhe chalai oh bhaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only then falling on the feet and becoming dust, the humble one can mould  himself according to the divine Will (hukam) of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":200932,"page_no":4,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਜਾਇ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"haumai jai ta jai sin(j)aanai ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only when ego is  erased, this fact is realized and identified."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40107,"next":40109}}
files.shabads/80/40109.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40109,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":4,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":200933,"last_verse_id":200940,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":200933,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੨੦ : ਦੂਜ ਦੇ ਚੰਦ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼","translit_en":"pauRee 20 : dhooj dhe cha(n)dh to(n) upadhesh","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lesson from moon of the second phase"}}},{"verse_id":200934,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਦੁਇ ਦਿਹਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਅਲੋਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਤੀਐ ਦਿਹ ਚੜ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਕਾ।","translit_en":"dhui dheh cha(n)dh alop hoi teeaai dheh chaRhadhaa hoi nikaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Remaining invisible for two days, third day the moon is beholden in a small  size."}}},{"verse_id":200935,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਜੁਹਾਰਦਾ ਗਗਨ ਮਹੇਸੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਟਿਕਾ।","translit_en":"auTh uTh jagat juhaaradhaa gagan mahesur masatak Tikaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Supposed to adorn the forehead of Mahesa, people bow to it again  and again."}}},{"verse_id":200936,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਲਹ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਘਾਰੀਐ ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਇਕਾ।","translit_en":"soleh kalaa sa(n)ghaareeaai safal janam sohai kal ikaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When it has attained all the sixteen phases i.e. on the full moon night, it begins diminishing and again reaches the position of the first day. People now bow before it."}}},{"verse_id":200937,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਨਿਝਰੁ ਝਰੈ ਸਿੰਜੈ ਸਹਸਿਕਾ।","translit_en":"a(n)mirat kiran suhaavanee nijhar jharai si(n)jai sahasikaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Nectar is sprinkled by its rays and it irrigates  all thirsty trees and fields."}}},{"verse_id":200938,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਰਤਨ ਅਮਿਕਾ।","translit_en":"seetal saa(n)t sa(n)tokh dhe sahaj sa(n)jogee ratan amikaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Peace, contentment and cool, these invaluable  jewels are bestowed by it."}}},{"verse_id":200939,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਕਰੈ ਅਨੇਰਹੁ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਡੋਰ ਚਕੋਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਛਿਕਾ।","translit_en":"karai anerahu chaananaa ddor chakor dhiaan dhar chhikaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In darkness, it spreads light and provides the  thread of meditation to the chakor, the redlegged partridge."}}},{"verse_id":200940,"page_no":4,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਅਮੋਲ ਮਣਿਕਾ ॥੨੦॥","translit_en":"aap gavai amol manikaa ||20||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Only by erasing  its ego it becomes an invaluable jewel."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40108,"next":40110}}

miracles."}}},{"verse_id":201004,"page_no":5,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਮਣੀ ਰਸਾਇਣਾ ਕਰਾਮਾਤ ਕਾਲਖ ਆਨ੍ਹੇਰੇ।","translit_en":"paaras manee rasainaa karaamaat kaalakh (like cows) and the cows only give milk and increase their lineage."}}},{"verse_id":201100,"page_no":5,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਫਲ ਬਿਰਖ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਮਾਣਸ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"safal birakh nihachal matee nihafal maanas dheh dhis dhaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The tree full of fruits is stable at one place whereas a vain person always runs here and there."}}},{"verse_id":201101,"page_no":5,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਿ ਤਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਸੀਅਲਾ ਸਿਰੁ ਉਚਾ ਨੀਵਾਂ ਦਿਖਲਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"ag tatee jal seealaa sir uchaa neevaa(n) dhikhalaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fire is full of heat (of ego) and keeps its head high but the water being cold always goes downward."}}},{"verse_id":201102,"page_no":5,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh aap gavaiaa manmukh moorakh aap ganaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurmukh divests his soul of ego but the manmukh, the fool always counts himself (above all)."}}},{"verse_id":201103,"page_no":5,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕੁਦਾਉ ਹਰਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"dhoojaa bhaau kudhaau haraavai ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having sense of duality is not a good conduct, and one always is defeated."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40128,"next":40130}}

ਸੁ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਾਗੇ।","translit_en":"dha(n)n pal chasaa ghaRee pahar dha(n)n dha(n)n thit su vaar sabhaage|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Blessed is the moment, the blinking time, the hour, the date, the day (during which you remember the Lord)."}}},{"verse_id":201263,"page_no":6,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਖੁ ਮਾਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੇ।","translit_en":"dha(n)n dha(n)n dhih raat hai pakh ego."}}},{"verse_id":201265,"page_no":6,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ।","translit_en":"dha(n)n dha(n)n sa(n)jog hai aThasaTh teerath raaj piraage|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That time is fortunate wherein (through meditation on God) one gets the fruits of the holy dip at the sixty eight pilgrim centers and the Prayagraj."}}},{"verse_id":201266,"page_no":6,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਗੇ।","translit_en":"guroo dhuaarai aai kai charan kaval ras a(n)mrit paage|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Reaching the door of Guru (the Gurudwara) mind gets absorbed in the delight of the lotus feet (of Guru)."}}},{"verse_id":201267,"page_no":6,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਰੀ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੇ।","translit_en":"gur upadhes aves kar anabhai piram piree anuraage|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Adopting the teachings of Guru, the state of fearlessness and total absorption in the love (of Lord) is attained."}}},{"verse_id":201268,"page_no":6,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਗੇ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g a(n)g a(n)g ik ra(n)g samaage|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Immersing the consciousness in the shabad (word) through and in the holy congregation, every limb (of the devotee) reverberates the lustre of the (steadfast) colour of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":201269,"page_no":6,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਰਤਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਚੇ ਧਾਗੇ ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"ratan maal kar kache dhaage ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Sikhs of the Guru have made jewel garland of the fragile thread of breath (and they make full use of the same)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40147,"next":40149}}

ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਸੋਈ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh miThaa bolanaa jo bolai soiee jap jaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The polite language of a Sikh brings out what he thinks in his mind and heart."}}},{"verse_id":201272,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਣਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰੈ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh akhee dhekhanaa braham dhiaan dharai aap aapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A Sikh beholds God everywhere with his own eyes, and that is equal to a yogi's meditation."}}},{"verse_id":201273,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪੰਚ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਲਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sunanaa surat kar pa(n)ch sabadh gur sabadh alaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When a Sikh listens attentively to, or himself  sings, the word of God, that is equal to the five ecstatic sounds in the brain of a yogi."}}},{"verse_id":201274,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਡੰਡਉਤਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh kirat kamaavanee namasakaar dda(n)ddaut sin(j)aapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earning livelihood with his hands by a Sikh is equal to the obeisance and prostration (of Hindus)."}}},{"verse_id":201275,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਪਰਦਖਣਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh maarag chalanaa paradhakhanaa pooran parataapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When, the gurmukh, walks to behold the Guru, that is equal to an extremely holy circumambulation."}}},{"verse_id":201276,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਪਛਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh khaanaa painanaa jog bhog sa(n)jog pachhaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the Guru oriented person eats and clothes himself, that is equal to the performance of Hindu sacrifice and offering."}}},{"verse_id":201277,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਣੁ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh savan samaadh hai aape aap na thaap uthaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When gurmukh sleeps, that is equal to a yogi's trance and the gurmukh withdraws not his  thoughts from the object (God the Guru) of his concentration."}}},{"verse_id":201278,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਘਰਬਾਰੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਲਹਿਰ ਨ ਭਵਜਲ ਭਉ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ।","translit_en":"gharabaaree jeevan mukat lahir na bhavajal bhau na biaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The householder is liberated in life; he is not afraid of the waves of the world's ocean and fear does not enter his heart."}}},{"verse_id":201279,"page_no":6,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਿ ਪਏ ਲੰਘਿ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"paar pe la(n)gh varai saraapai ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He goes beyond the region of blessings and curses, and does not utter them."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40148,"next":40150}}

meditation is well known (to the gurmukh)."}}},{"verse_id":201282,"page_no":6,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੂਲ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"sat naam karataa purakh mool aanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He enters into the immersion of word-consciousness through the Guru and the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":201285,"page_no":6,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਲਣੁ ਭਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th aga(n)m hai gurmat nihachal chalan bhaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The way of the gurmukh is beyond the ken of mind  and speech and he in accordance with the wisdom of the Guru and his own steadfast will, treads on it."}}},{"verse_id":201286,"page_no":6,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਹੁਂ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਉਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"vedh katebahu(n) baaharee akath kathaa kaun aakh vakhaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who can describe the importance of the parable (of the gurmukh) because it is beyond the Vedas and the Katebas, (the  four holy books of semitic religion)."}}},{"verse_id":201287,"page_no":6,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh sin(j)aanai ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This way can be identified only by crossing the limits and anxieties about the high and low of the world."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40149,"next":40151}}

ruddy sheldrake, the moon."}}},{"verse_id":201291,"page_no":6,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿੰਮਲ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਨ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਵਾਂਸਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"si(n)mal birakh na safal hoi cha(n)dhan vaas na vaa(n)s samaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The silk cotton (simbal) tree yields no fruit and the bamboo grows near the sandal but is not perfumed thereby."}}},{"verse_id":201292,"page_no":6,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਲੀਐ ਤੁਮੇ ਦਾ ਕਉੜਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"sapai dhudh peeaaleeaai tume dhaa kauRat na jaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Given milk to drink, a serpent does not part with its poison and the bitterness of the colocynth also does not depart."}}},{"verse_id":201293,"page_no":6,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉ ਥਣਿ ਚੰਬੜਿ ਚਿਚੁੜੀ ਲੋਹੂ ਪੀਐ ਦੁਧੁ ਨ ਖਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"jiau than cha(n)baR chichuRee lohoo peeaai dhudh na khaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The tick clings to the cow's udder but drinks blood instead of milk."}}},{"verse_id":201294,"page_no":6,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਵਸਨਿ ਗੁਣ ਕੀਤੇ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਨੋ ਧਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"sabh avagun mai tan vasan gun keete avagun no dhaavai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"All these demerits I have and if any one do me a favour, I return it with undesirable trait."}}},{"verse_id":201295,"page_no":6,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਥੋਮ ਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੂਰੀ ਆਵੈ ॥੨੦॥੬॥","translit_en":"thom na vaas kathooree aavai ||20||6||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Garlic can never have the perfume of musk."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40150,"next":40152}}

rahaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They preach to all the four varnas and themselves remain indifferent in the midst of maya."}}},{"verse_id":201302,"page_no":7,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ highest and only this mantra should be recited with deep integrity."}}},{"verse_id":201303,"page_no":7,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮੰਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko ma(n)nai hukamu su sach samaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everything is subsumed in the divine order and whosoever bows his head before His order, merges in the attuned to the Word makes man competent to behold the invisible Lord."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40151,"next":40153}}

Gurmukh,"}}},{"verse_id":201306,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਨੋ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜ ਦਿਹੁਂ ਰਾਤਿ ਸਧਾਏ।","translit_en":"siv sakatee no saadh kai cha(n)dh sooraj dhihu(n) raat sadhaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Conquering Siva and S'akti (the rajas and tamas qualities), the gurmukhs have disciplined the moon-sun (ira, pingala) and also the time known by days and nights."}}},{"verse_id":201307,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਸਾਧੇ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਨਰਕ ਸੁਰਗ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪ ਲੰਘਾਏ।","translit_en":"sukh dhukh saadhe harakh sog narak surag pu(n)n paap la(n)ghaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Subjugating pleasure and pain, joy and suffering, they have gone beyond hell and heaven, sin and virtue."}}},{"verse_id":201308,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭਲਾ ਬੁਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਏ।","translit_en":"janam maran jeevan mukat bhalaa buraa mitrr satrr nivaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They have humbled life, death, liberation in life, right and wrong, enemy and friend."}}},{"verse_id":201309,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਜ ਜੋਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਰਹਾਏ।","translit_en":"raaj jog jin vas kar saadh sa(n)jog vijog rahaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being victors of raj and yoga (temporality and spirituality), they have disciplined alliance  as well as separation."}}},{"verse_id":201310,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਵਸਗਤਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਨੀਂਦ ਭੂਖ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ।","translit_en":"vasagat keetee nee(n)dh bhookh aasaa manasaa jin ghar aae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Conquering sleep, hunger, hope and desire, they have made their abode in their own true nature."}}},{"verse_id":201311,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਉਸਤੁਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣ ਸਬਾਏ।","translit_en":"ausatut ni(n)dhaa saadh kai hi(n)dhoo musalamaan sabaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Going beyond praise and slander, they have become beloved of the Hindus as well as Muslims."}}},{"verse_id":201312,"page_no":7,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਪਾ ਖਾਕ ਸਦਾਏ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"pairee pai paa khaak sadhaae ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They bow before all and consider themselves as dust."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40152,"next":40154}}

la(n)gh tirabenee nhaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Crossing trikuti, the conjunction of three naris – ira, pingala, susumna in between the  eyebrows, they have bathed in the triveni, the pilgrimage gurmukh assimilates even the six philosophies."}}},{"verse_id":201339,"page_no":7,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਛਿਅ ਰਸ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਣੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤੀ।","translit_en":"chhia ras rasanaa saadh kai raag raaganee bhai bhagatee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He conquers the six tastes (sour, sweet, astringent, bitter, tart and saltish) of the tongue and along with six musical measures and their consorts surrenders with full devotions."}}},{"verse_id":201340,"page_no":7,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਛਿਅ ਚਿਰਜੀਵੀ ਛਿਅ ਜਤੀ ਚੱਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਛਿਅ ਸਾਧਿ ਜੁਗਤੀ।","translit_en":"chhia chirajeevee chhia jatee cha'kravarat chakras."}}},{"verse_id":201341,"page_no":7,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਛਿਅ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਛਿਅ ਕਰਮ ਜਿਣਿ ਛਿਆ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਤੀ।","translit_en":"chhia saasatr chhia karam jin chhiaa guraa(n) gur surat philosophies)."}}},{"verse_id":201342,"page_no":7,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਛਿਅ ਵਰਤਾਰੇ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਛਿਅ ਛਕ ਛਤੀ ਪਵਣ ਪਰਤੀ।","translit_en":"chhia varataare saadh kai chhia chhak chhatee pavan ਦੀਪ ਸਤ ਇਕੁ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਬਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sat samu(n)dh ula(n)ghiaa dheep sat ik dheepak baliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Getting above of the seven oceans and seven Continents, the gurmukh lights the lamp of knowledge."}}},{"verse_id":201346,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤ ਸੂਤ ਇਕ ਸੂਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਤੇ ਪੁਰੀਆ ਲੰਘਿ ਉਛਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sat soot ik soot kar sate pureeaa la(n)gh uchhaliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He binds the seven threads (five organs, mind and wisdom) of body into one thread (of high consciousness) and goes across  the seven (mythological) habitats (puris)."}}},{"verse_id":201347,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤ ਸਤੀ ਜਿਣਿ ਸਪਤ ਰਿਖਿ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਰਾ ਜਿਣਿ ਅਟਲੁ ਨ ਟਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sat satee jin sapat rikh sat suraa jin aTal na resolves."}}},{"verse_id":201348,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤੇ ਸੀਵਾਂ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਤੀਂ ਸੀਵੀਂ ਸੁਫਲਿਓ ਫਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sate seevaa(n) saadh kai satee(n) seevee(n) sufalio stages."}}},{"verse_id":201349,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤ ਆਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਤ ਵਸਿਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਉਪਰੇਰੈ ਚਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sat aakaas pataal sat vasigat kar uparerai chaliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Controlling the seven nether worlds and seven skies he goes beyond them."}}},{"verse_id":201350,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤੇ ਧਾਰੀ ਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਭੈਰਉ ਖੇਤ੍ਰ੍ਰਪਾਲ ਦਲ ਮਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sate dhaaree la(n)gh kai bhairau khetrrapaal dhal maliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Getting across the seven streams, he decimates the armies of Bhairav and other protectors of the worlds."}}},{"verse_id":201351,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਤੇ ਰੋਹਣਿ ਸਤਿ ਵਾਰ ਸਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਸਾਧਿ ਨ ਢਲਿਆ।","translit_en":"sate rohan sat vaar sat suhaagan saadh na ddaliaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The seven rohinis seven days and the seven married women and their ritualistic activities cannot upset him."}}},{"verse_id":201352,"page_no":7,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਖਲਿਆ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat vich khaliaa ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurmukh always remains stabilized in the true congregation."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40157,"next":40159}}

ਕਰਾਈ।","translit_en":"aTh kaaThaa man vas kar asaT dhaat ik dhaat karaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Controlling the mind comprising eight inclinations, the gurmukh has made it homogenous as the ਲਖਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"dhas avataar akaar kar eka(n)kaar na alakh lakhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even the ten incarnations (of Vishnu) when they came in human form did not see that invisible Oankar."}}},{"verse_id":201372,"page_no":7,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬੀਂ ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"teerath purab sa(n)jog vich dhas purabee(n) gur purab na Gurus."}}},{"verse_id":201373,"page_no":7,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"eik man ik na chetio saadhasa(n)gat vin dheh dhis directions."}}},{"verse_id":201374,"page_no":7,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਦਸ ਦਹੀਆਂ ਦਸ ਅਸ੍ਵਮੇਧ ਖਾਇ ਅਮੇਧ ਨਿਖੇਧੁ ਕਰਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"dhas dhaheeaa(n) dhas asavaimedh khai amedh nikhedh (Sikhism)."}}},{"verse_id":201375,"page_no":7,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਇੰਦਰੀਆਂ ਦਸ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"ei(n)dhareeaa(n) dhas vas kar baahar jaa(n)dhaa varaj rahaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gurmukh, controlling the ten organs stops the mind racing in ten directions."}}},{"verse_id":201376,"page_no":7,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਪੈਰੀ ਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧੦॥","translit_en":"pairee pai jag pairee paiaa ||10||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He humbly bows at the Guru's feet and the whole world falls at his feet."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40160,"next":40162}}
files.shabads/80/40162.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40162,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":7,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":201377,"last_verse_id":201384,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":201377,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਏਕਾਦਸ਼ ਸੰਖ੍ਯਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ","translit_en":"pauRee 11 : ekaadhash sa(n)khayaa gurmukh","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Counting by eleven - the gurmukh"}}},{"verse_id":201378,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਇਕਾਦਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਰਤੁ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਭਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"eik man hoi ikaadhasee gurmukh varat patibrat bhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like a faithful wife, gurmukh likes the fast of ekadasi in the form of concentration of mind (Hindus generally observe fast on the eleventh day of lunar month)."}}},{"verse_id":201379,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਰਹ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਸਮੰੁਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਲ ਦਾ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"giaareh rudhrr sama(n)udhr vich pal dhaa paaraavaar na paiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eleven Rudras (different forms of Siva) could not understand the mystery of this world - ocean."}}},{"verse_id":201380,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਰਹ ਕਸ ਗਿਆਰਹ ਕਸੇ ਕਸਿ ਕਸਵੱਟੀ ਕਸ ਕਸਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"giaareh kas giaareh kase kas kasava'Tee kas kasaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukh has controlled all the eleven (ten organs and the mind). Their eleven objects also he has controlled and he has purified the mind-gold by rubbing it on the touchstone  of devotion."}}},{"verse_id":201381,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਰਹ ਗੁਣ ਫੈਲਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਕਚ ਪਕਾਈ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"giaareh gun failaau kar kach pakaiee aghaR ghaRaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Cultivating eleven virtues he has chiseled and stabilized the tardy mind."}}},{"verse_id":201382,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਰਹ ਦਾਉ ਚੜ੍ਹਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਕੁਦਾਉ ਰਹਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"giaareh dhaau chaRhaau kar dhoojaa bhaau kudhaau rahaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Assuming eleven virtues (truth, contentment, compassion, dharma, control, devotion etc.) he has erased duality and dubiousness."}}},{"verse_id":201383,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਰਹ ਗੇੜਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖੁ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"giaareh geRaa sikh sun gur sikh lai gursikh sadhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the mantra eleven times, the gurmukh adopting the teaching of the Guru, is called Gursikh."}}},{"verse_id":201384,"page_no":7,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh vasaiaa ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the holy congregation only the Word-Guru resides in one's heart."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40161,"next":40163}}

simple and straight way (for liberation)."}}},{"verse_id":201387,"page_no":7,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰਜ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਸੀਅਰੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਮਾਹਿ ਫਿਰਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"sooraj baareh maeh vich saseear ikat maeh firaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It looks as if the sun circumambulates earth in twelve months and the moon in one month but the fact is that the work completed by the person having tamas ਸਮਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"baareh soleh mel kar saseear a(n)dhar soor samaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Combining twelve (months) and sixteen (phases of moon) the sun merges into the moon i.e. rajas and tamas get absobed into the sattva."}}},{"verse_id":201389,"page_no":7,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਰਹ ਤਿਲਕ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"baareh tilak miTai kai gurmukh tilak neesaan chaRaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gurmukh repudiating the twelve types of marks on forehead only keeps on his head the mark of the love of Lord."}}},{"verse_id":201390,"page_no":7,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਰਹ ਰਾਸੀ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"baareh raasee saadh kai sach raas raharaas lubhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Conquering the twelve zodiac signs, the gurmukh remains absorbed in the capital of truthful conduct."}}},{"verse_id":201391,"page_no":7,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਰਹ ਵੰਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਬਾਰਹ ਮਾਸੇ ਤੋਲਿ ਤੁਲਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"baareh va(n)nee hoi kai baareh maase tol tulaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becoming pure gold of twelve masas (twenty four carats) they come true to their worth in the world market."}}},{"verse_id":201392,"page_no":7,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸ ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"paaras paaras paras karaiaa ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of Guru, the gurmukhs also become philosopher's stones."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40162,"next":40164}}

files.shabads/80/40165.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40165,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":7,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":201401,"last_verse_id":201408,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":201401,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ੧੪ -੧੫ -੧੬ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ-ਗੁਰਮੁਖ","translit_en":"pauRee 14 : 14 -15 -16 dhee ginatee-gurmukh","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Counting by Fourteen, Fifteen and Sixteen -the gurmukh"}}},{"verse_id":201402,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਚਉਦਹ ਵਿਦਿਆ ਸਾਧਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"chaudheh vidhiaa saadh kai gurmat abigat akath kahaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Accomplishing the fourteen skills, gurmukhs adopt the indescribable skill of the wisdom of Guru (Gurmat)."}}},{"verse_id":201403,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਚਉਦਹ ਭਵਣ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"chaudheh bhavan ula(n)gh kai nij ghar vaas neh nirabaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Going across the fourteen worlds they reside in their own self and remain immersed in the state of nirvana."}}},{"verse_id":201404,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪੰਦ੍ਰਹ ਥਿਤੀ ਪਖੁ ਇਕੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਸੁਕਲ ਦੁਇ ਪਖ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"pa(n)dhreh thitee pakh ik kirasan sukal dhui pakh neesaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One  fortnight consists of fifteen days; one is the dark (krsna) fortnight and the second is moonlit light (sukla) fortnight."}}},{"verse_id":201405,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਲਹ ਸਾਰ ਸੰਘਾਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਜੋੜਾ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"soleh saar sa(n)ghaar kar joRaa juRiaa nirabhau jaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Like the game of dice, ousting the sixteen counters and making the pair only, one attains fearlessness."}}},{"verse_id":201406,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋਲਹ ਕਲਾ ਸੰਪੂਰਣੋ ਸਸਿ ਘਰਿ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਵਿਰਤੀਹਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"soleh kalaa sa(n)poorano sas ghar sooraj virateehaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the moon, the master of sixteen phases (full of sattvic quality), enters into the sun (full of rajas and tamas), it gets faded."}}},{"verse_id":201407,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਰਿ ਸੋਲਹ ਸੀਂਗਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਜ ਭਤਾਰ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਮਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"naar soleh see(n)gaar kar sej bhataar piram ras maanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Woman also using sixteen types of adornments goes to the bed of her husband and enjoys the extreme  delight."}}},{"verse_id":201408,"page_no":7,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਤੈ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਤਾਰਹ ਵਾਣੀ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"siv tai sakat sataareh vaanee ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The power (sakti) of Siva i.e. maya keeps with her seventeen speeches or variations of its powers."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40164,"next":40166}}

files.shabads/80/40218.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40218,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":10,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":12,"first_verse_id":201792,"last_verse_id":201803,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":201792,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ॥","translit_en":"ikOankaar satigur prasaadh||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor"}}},{"verse_id":201793,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧ : ਧ੍ਰੂ ਭਗਤ","translit_en":"pauRee 1 : dhraoo bhagat","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of the divine preceptor"}}},{"verse_id":201794,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਧ੍ਰੂ ਹਸਦਾ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਪਿਉ ਕੁਛੜਿ ਲੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"dhraoo hasadhaa ghar aaiaa kar piaar piau kuchhaR leetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Boy Dhru came smiling to his house (palace) and his father full of love put him into his lap."}}},{"verse_id":201795,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਹਹੁ ਪਕੜਿ ਉਠਾਲਿਆ ਮਨ ਵਿਚਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੇਈ ਕੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"baahahu pakaR uThaaliaa man vich ros matreiee keetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing this, the stepmother got angry and catching hold of his arm pushed him out of the lap of the father (the king)."}}},{"verse_id":201796,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਡੁਡਹੁਲਿਕਾ ਮਾਂ ਪੁਛੈ ਤੂੰ ਸਾਵਾਣੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸੁਰੀਤਾ?","translit_en":"dduddahulikaa maa(n) puchhai too(n) saavaanee hai k sureetaa?","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Tearful with fear he asked his mother whether she was a queen or a maidservant?"}}},{"verse_id":201797,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਵਾਣੀ ਹਾਂ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਰਮਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ੍ਹੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"saavaanee haa(n) janam dhee naam na bhagatee karam dhiraRheetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O son! (said she) I was born queen but I did not remember God and did not undertake acts of devotion (and this is the reason of yours and mine plight)."}}},{"verse_id":201798,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਸੁ ਉਦਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਜੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤ੍ਰੂ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਹੋਵਨਿ ਮੀਤਾ?।","translit_en":"kis udham te raaj mil satraoo te sabh hovan meetaa?|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With that effort can the kingdom be had (asked Dhru) and how can enemies turn friends?"}}},{"verse_id":201799,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਜਿਦੂ ਹੋਈਐ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"paramesar aaraadheeaai jidhoo hoieeaai patit puneetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord should be worshipped and thus the sinners also become sacred ones (said the mother)."}}},{"verse_id":201800,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਹਰਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਕਰਣਿ ਤਪੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਤੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"baahar chaliaa karan tap man bairaagee hoi ateetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to this and getting totally detached in his mind Dhru went out (to the jungle) to undertake rigorous discipline."}}},{"verse_id":201801,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਰਦ ਮੁਨਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਅਮਿਓ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"naaradh mun upadhesiaa naam nidhaan amio ras peetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On the way, sage Narad taught him the technique of devotion and Dhru quaffed the nectar from the ocean of the Name of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":201802,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਛਹੁ ਰਾਜੇ ਸਦਿਆ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਾ।","translit_en":"pichhahu raaje sadhiaa abichal raaj karahu nit neetaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(After some time) King (Uttanpad) called him back and asked him (Dhru) to rule forever."}}},{"verse_id":201803,"page_no":10,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਹਾਰਿ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਗ ਜੀਤਾ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"haar chale gurmukh jag jeetaa ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukhs who seem to be losing i.e. who turn their faces from the evil propensities, conquer the world."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40216,"next":40219}}

?"}}},{"verse_id":201910,"page_no":10,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਹਸਿ ਕੈ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਨੋ ਕਹਿ ਸਮਝਾਵੈ।","translit_en":"has kai Thaakur boliaa naamadheau no keh files.shabads/80/40233.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40233,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":10,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":10,"first_verse_id":201945,"last_verse_id":201954,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":201945,"page_no":10,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਸੈਣ ਨਾਈ","translit_en":"pauRee 16 : sain naiee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sain, the barber"}}},{"verse_id":201946,"page_no":10,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਣਿ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਦਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸੈਣੁ ਨਾਈ।","translit_en":"sun parataap kabeer dhaa dhoojaa sikh hoaa sain naiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Hearing of glory of Kabir, Sain also turned to be a disciple."}}},{"verse_id":201947,"page_no":10,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਭਲਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਜਾਈ।","translit_en":"prem bhagat raatee karai bhalakai raaj dhuaarai jaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the night he would immerse in loving devotion and in the morning he would serve at the door of the king."}}},{"verse_id":201948,"page_no":10,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਆਏ ਸੰਤ ਪਰਾਹੁਣੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ।","translit_en":"aae sa(n)t paraahune keeratan hoaa rain sabaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On one night some sadhus came to him and the whole night was spent in singing the Lord's praises"}}},{"verse_id":201949,"page_no":10,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਛਡਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਜ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈ।","translit_en":"chhadd na sakai sa(n)t jan raaj dhuaar na sev kamaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sain could not leave company of the saints and consequently did not perform the king’s service the following morning."}}},{"verse_id":201950,"page_no":10,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸੈਣ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਕੈ ਆਇਆ ਰਾਣੈ ਨੋ ਰੀਝਾਈ।","translit_en":"sain roop har jai kai aaiaa raanai no reejhaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"God himself took the form of Sain. Lord."}}},{"verse_id":202038,"page_no":11,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਹਾਰੀ।","translit_en":"aadh purakh aadhes kar a(n)mrit velaa sabadh teaching of the Guru, the disciples have themselves become the house of all pleasures."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40245,"next":40247}}
files.shabads/80/40247.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40247,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":11,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":202078,"last_verse_id":202086,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":202078,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੭ : ਏਕਤਾ ਪਰ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟਾਂਤ","translit_en":"pauRee 7 : ekataa par dhirashaTaa(n)t","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Example of unity"}}},{"verse_id":202079,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਤਮੋਲ ਗੁਲਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"chaar varan ik varan kar varan avaran tamol gulaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As in betel leaf all the colours mix and become one red colour, likewise mixing all the varnas one Sikh has been created."}}},{"verse_id":202080,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਚਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"asaT dhaat ik dhaat kar vedh kateb na bhedh vichaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Eight metals mixing up make one metal (alloy); similarly there is no difference among Vedas and the Katebas (the Semitic scriptures)."}}},{"verse_id":202081,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸੁਪਤਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasupat afal safal vich vaas bahaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sandal perfumes the whole vegetation whether it is devoid of fruit or full of fruit."}}},{"verse_id":202082,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਲੋਹਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"lohaa suinaa hoi kai suinaa hoi suga(n)dh vikhaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Touching the philosopher’s stone, iron becoming gold, again points towards its further beauty (of making itself useful for the needy ones)."}}},{"verse_id":202083,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਇਨੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਚਰਣਾਮਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"suine a(n)dhar ra(n)g ras charanaamit a(n)mrit matavaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then in gold in the form of gurmukh, the colour (of Name) and elixir (of love) enter and he becomes carefree of the world around."}}},{"verse_id":202084,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੁਇਨਿਅਹੁ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"maanak motee suiniahu jagamag jot heere paravaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now all the qualities of rubies, pearls, diamonds emerge in that gold-gurmukh."}}},{"verse_id":202085,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਬ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦਿਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲੇ।","translit_en":"dhib dheh dhib dhisaT hoi sabadh surat dhib jot ujaale|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becoming divine body and divine sight the consciousness of gurmukh concentrates on the light of the divine Word."}}},{"verse_id":202086,"page_no":11,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਰਸਿਕ ਰਸਾਲੇ ॥੭॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal rasik rasaale ||7||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus, adopting the delight of devotion, the gurmukhs become full of many delights."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40246,"next":40248}}

paiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the roar of clouds they dance like rain bird and peacock."}}},{"verse_id":202091,"page_no":11,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪੁਟ ਹੁਇ ਭਵਰੁ ਸਮਾਈ।","translit_en":"charan kaval makara(n)dh ras sukh sa(n)puT hui bhavar samaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"To taste the nectar of the lotus feet they turn themselves into the black bee and meen hoi gurmukh chaal na khoj khujaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The way of the gurmukhs is not known to anybody; similar to fish they live in the ocean of happiness."}}},{"verse_id":202093,"page_no":11,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਅਪਿਓ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਨਿਝਰ ਝਰਣ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣ ਨ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਈ।","translit_en":"apio peean nijhar jharan ajar jaran na alakh lakhaiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They drink nectar; from them gush forth the springs of nectar; they assimilate the unbearable but still they do not make them noticed by any one."}}},{"verse_id":202094,"page_no":11,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਉਲੰਘਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਾਈ।","translit_en":"veeh ikeeh ula(n)gh kai gursikh gurmukh sukh fal paiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Going across all the stages (of three-dimensional nature-prakarti) they attain the fruits of delights."}}},{"verse_id":202095,"page_no":11,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੮॥","translit_en":"vaahiguroo vaddee vaddiaaiee ||8||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wondrous is the Vaheguru whose greatness is grand."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40247,"next":40249}}

asamaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The florican also under its full care makes its offspring fly in the sky."}}},{"verse_id":202099,"page_no":11,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਬਤਕ ਬੱਚਾ ਤੁਰਿ ਤੁਰੈ ਜਲ ਥਲ order."}}},{"verse_id":202121,"page_no":11,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸੁ ਕੂੜ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਖੀਰੁ ਵਿਲੋਈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh va(n)see param ha(n)s kooR sach neer kheer wisdom."}}},{"verse_id":202122,"page_no":11,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"gur chelaa chelaa gur hoiee ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(In the holy congregation) the disciple is the Guru and the Guru (most humbly) becomes disciple."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40250,"next":40252}}
files.shabads/80/40252.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40252,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":11,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":202123,"last_verse_id":202131,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":202123,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਗੁਰਸਿੱਖ ਸੰਧੀ","translit_en":"pauRee 12 : gursi'kh sa(n)dhee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wisdom of Gurmukhs"}}},{"verse_id":202124,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕਛੂ ਬੱਚਾ ਨਦੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲਹਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ।","translit_en":"kachhoo ba'chaa nadhee vich gursikh lahar na bhavajal biaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the offspring of tortoise are not affected by sea waves so is the case of the Sikhs of Guru; they are not influenced by the waves of the World Ocean."}}},{"verse_id":202125,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕੂੰਜ ਬੱਚਾ ਲੈਇ ਉਡਰੈ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"koo(n)j ba'chaa lai uddarai su(n)n samaadh agaadh na jaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Florican bird flies comfortably along with its offspring in the sky but the sky does not look abysmal to it."}}},{"verse_id":202126,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਹੰਸੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮਾਨਸਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"ha(n)s va(n)s hai maanasar sahaj sarovar vadd parataapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The progeny of swans reside in the all potent Manasarovar."}}},{"verse_id":202127,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਬੱਤਕ ਬੱਚਾ ਕੋਇਲੈ ਨੰਦ ਨੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਵ ਮਿਲਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"ba'tak ba'chaa koilai na(n)dh na(n)dhan vaasudhev milaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The goose and nightingale separate their progeny from hens and crows respectively and though living among milkman Krishna ultimately went to Vasudev; likewise, the gurmukh giving up all the evil propensities goes to merge in the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":202128,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਰਵਿ ਸਸਿ ਚਕਵੀ ਤੈ ਚਕੋਰ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਲੰਘਿ ਵਰੈ ਸਰਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"rav sas chakavee tai chakor siv sakatee la(n)gh varai saraapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the female ruddy sheldrake and redlegged partridge meet sun and moon respectively gurmukh also crossing the maya of Siva and Sakti attains the highest state of equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":202129,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਅਨਲ ਪੰਖਿ ਬੱਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਝੈ ਆਪੈ।","translit_en":"anal pa(n)kh ba'chaa milai niraadhaar hoi samajhai aapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The anal bird recognises its offspring even without any basis for its identification."}}},{"verse_id":202130,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣੀ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਪਛਾਪੈ।","translit_en":"gursikh sa(n)dh milaavanee sabadh surat parachai pachhaapai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"It is the state of Sikh who merging his consciousness in the Word, identifies the true love (of the Lord)."}}},{"verse_id":202131,"page_no":11,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਉਥਾਪੈ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal thaap uthaapai ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukhs identify and establish the fruits of delight."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40251,"next":40253}}
files.shabads/80/40253.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40253,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":11,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":10,"first_verse_id":202132,"last_verse_id":202141,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":202132,"page_no":11,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਪਹਿਲੀ ਪਾਤਿਸ਼ਾਹੀ ਦੇ ਸਿੱਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਨਾਮਾਵਲੀ","translit_en":"pauRee 13 : pahilee paatishaahee dhe si'khaa(n) dhee naamaavalee","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Inventory of the names of the Sikhs of Guru Nanak"}}},{"verse_id":202133,"page_no":11,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਤਾਰੂ ਪੋਪਟੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਉਦਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"taaroo popaT taariaa gurmukh baal subhai udhaasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Guru Nanak liberated detached natured Taru, a Sikh of popat clan, from childhood."}}},{"verse_id":202134,"page_no":11,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਮੂਲਾ ਕੀੜੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਚਲਿਤੁ ਅਚਰਜ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਗੁਰਦਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"moolaa keeR vakhaaneeaai chalit acharaj lubhit gurdhaasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There was one Mula of a wonderful nature; Ultimately they had to repent."}}},{"verse_id":202403,"page_no":12,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਸੁਕਦੇਉ ਕਰਿ ਗਰਭ ਵਾਸਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"aha(n)meau sukadheau kar garabh vaas haumai hairaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Because of his ego Sukadev also suffered for a long time (twelve years) in the womb of his mother."}}},{"verse_id":202404,"page_no":12,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਅਉਲੰਗ ਭਰੈ ਉਦੈ ਅਸਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"cha(n)dh sooraj aaula(n)g bharai udhai asat vich aavan jaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sun and moon also full of blemishes, indulge in the cycle of rising and setting."}}},{"verse_id":202405,"page_no":12,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਰਬੁ ਗੁਮਾਣੈ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"siv sakatee vich garab gumaanai ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Engrossed in maya they are all afflicted by ego."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40281,"next":40283}}

In Duapar, sinful act of one person made the whole family suffer."}}},{"verse_id":202441,"page_no":12,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਇਕੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"kalijug sach niaau hai jo beejai so lunai ikelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The justice of Kaliyuga is true because in it only he reaps who sows the evil seeds."}}},{"verse_id":202442,"page_no":12,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"paarabraham pooran braham sabadh surat satigur gur chelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Brahm is the perfect Sabdabrahm and that disciple who merges his consciousness in the Sabdabrahm is in fact Guru and the true Guru (God)."}}},{"verse_id":202443,"page_no":12,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"naam dhaan isanaan dhiraR saadhasa(n)gat mil a(n)mirat velaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sabdabrahm, the Guru is attained in the holy congregation by remembering the name of the Lord in the ambrosial hours."}}},{"verse_id":202444,"page_no":12,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਹਥਹੁ ਦੇਣਾ ਸਹਿਜ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"miThaa bolan niv chalan hathahu dhenaa sahij suhelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"A mild spoken, humble and giver through his hands moves in equipoise and remains happy."}}},{"verse_id":202445,"page_no":12,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal neh navelaa ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Ever new love of devotion to the Lord keeps the gurmukhs happy."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40286,"next":40288}}

miTaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Gurus giving them place at their feet removed their incurable malady of ego."}}},{"verse_id":202452,"page_no":12,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਚਲਣਾ files.shabads/80/40305.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40305,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":13,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":202571,"last_verse_id":202577,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":202571,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੪ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਕਿਕੂੰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ?","translit_en":"pauRee 14 : prem ras kikoo(n) miladhaa hai ?","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"How is the joy of love attained?"}}},{"verse_id":202572,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਹੁਇ ਗੁਰੁਸਿਖ ਮੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal piram ras hui gurusikh melaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"After meeting the Guru i.e. after adopting the teachings of the Guru, the gurmukh receives the pleasure-fruit of the joy of love."}}},{"verse_id":202573,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇ ਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੇਹੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat parachai kai nit neh navelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Guru merges the consciousness of the disciple into the Word and creates ever-new love for the Lord in it."}}},{"verse_id":202574,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਵੀਹ ਇਕੀਹ ਚੜਾਉ ਚੜਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"veeh ikeeh chaRaau chaR sikh gur gur chelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Thus getting above the worldliness, the disciple becomes Guru and the Guru disciple."}}},{"verse_id":202575,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਅਪਿਉ ਪੀਐ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"apiau peeaai ajar jarai gur sev suhelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now he quaffs the unbearable drink of the juice of love and further bears the unbearable. But all this becomes possible only through the service of the Guru"}}},{"verse_id":202576,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਹਾਰਿ ਜਿਣੈ ਵਹੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"jeevadhiaa mar chalanaa haar jinai vahelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(To attain the delight of love) One has to put to death his ego and by becoming indifferent to the world has to conquer it."}}},{"verse_id":202577,"page_no":13,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਲ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਲਖ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੇਲਾ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"sil aloonee chaTanee lakh a(n)mirat pelaa ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who has licked this tasteless (unsalty) stone i.e. who has adopted the way of desireless devotion, he alone throws away myriads of delights equal to the immortalising elixirs."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40304,"next":40306}}

||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The way of the gurmukhs is also the same; they without the caring for the loss and the profit go on moving further and further."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40305,"next":40307}}

ha(n)ddaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Plenty of gold, wealth, rubies and pearls are worn by man."}}},{"verse_id":202904,"page_no":15,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਟ ਪਟੰਬਰ ਪੈਨ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਚੋਆ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਕਾਏ।","translit_en":"paaT paTa(n)bar painh ke choaa cha(n)dhan meh mahakaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wearing silken garment scatters around the fragrance of sandal etc."}}},{"verse_id":202905,"page_no":15,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਹਾਥੀ ਘੋੜੇ ਪਾਖਰੇ ਮਹਲ ਬਗੀਚੇ ਸੁਫਲ ਫਲਾਏ।","translit_en":"haathee ghoRe paakhare mahal bageeche sufal falaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Man keeps elephants, horses, palaces, and fruit laden gardens."}}},{"verse_id":202906,"page_no":15,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਸੇਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਧੋਹਿ ਲਪਟਾਏ।","translit_en":"su(n)dhar naaree sej sukh maiaa moh dhoh lapaTaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Enjoying the pleasure-giving bed along with beautiful women, he remains engrossed in many deceptions and infatuations."}}},{"verse_id":202907,"page_no":15,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਬਲਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤੇਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਏ।","translit_en":"baladhee a(n)dhar tel jiau aasaa manasaa dhukh vihaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They all are fuels to the fire and man spends life in the sufferings of hopes and desires"}}},{"verse_id":202908,"page_no":15,"line_no":14,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧੪॥","translit_en":"gur poore vin jam pur jaae ||14||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He has to reach the abode of Yama (death god) if he remains without the perfect number."}}},{"verse_id":202914,"page_no":15,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਲਖ ਸਾਹ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਨਾਥ ਅਵਤਾਰੁ ਸੁਹਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"lakh saeh paatisaeh lakh lakh naath avataar suhaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bankers, emperors, naths and grand incarnations are also myriads in number."}}},{"verse_id":202915,"page_no":15,"line_no":15,"gurmukhi":"ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਦਾਤੈ ਕਉਣੁ ਸੁਮਾਰੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"dhaanai keemat naa pavai dhaatai kaun sumaar vakhaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When charities bestowed cannot be evaluated, how can one describe the extent of creation is sacrifice unto that creator Lord."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40350,"next":40352}}

govi(n)dh sin(j)aanai soiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The fact that the transcendental Brahm is the prefect Brahm and the Guru is God, is only identified by a gurmukh, the Guru-orientated one."}}},{"verse_id":202923,"page_no":15,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਣੋਈ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal sahaj ghar piram piaalaa jaan it."}}},{"verse_id":202924,"page_no":15,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥","translit_en":"gur chelaa chelaa gur hoiee ||16||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then the Guru and the ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"pat paravaanai tol tulaae ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whosoever becomes equal to such gurmukhs, is respected in the court of the Then life was infused in it and its grandeur was further enhanced."}}},{"verse_id":202936,"page_no":15,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁਹੁ ਅਖੀ ਦੇ ਨਕੁ ਕੰਨ ਹਥ ਪੈਰ ਦੰਦ ਵਾਲ ਗਣਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"muh akhee dhe nak ka(n)n hath pair dha(n)dh vaal ganaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Mouth, eyes, nose, ears, hands, teeth, hair etc. were bestowed upon it."}}},{"verse_id":202937,"page_no":15,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਦਿਸਟਿ ਸਬਦ ਗਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵੈ ਰਾਗ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਲੁਭਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"dhisaT sabadh gat surat livai raag ra(n)g ras paras lubhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Man was given sight, speech, power of listening and consciousness of merging in the Word. For his ears, eyes, tongue and skin, the form, joy, smell etc. were created."}}},{"verse_id":202938,"page_no":15,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤਮੁ ਕੁਲੁ ਉਤਮੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਗਣਿ ਅੰਗ ਸਬਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"autam kul utam janam rom rom gan a(n)g sabaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By giving the best family (of human being) and birth in it, the Lord god gave shape to one and all organs."}}},{"verse_id":202939,"page_no":15,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਦੁਧਿ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਲ ਮੂਤ੍ਰ ਸੂਤ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਇਆ।","translit_en":"baal budh muh dhudh dhe kar mal mootr sootr vich aaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"During infancy, mother pours milk into the mouth and make (the baby) defecate."}}},{"verse_id":202940,"page_no":15,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਹੋਇ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਸਮਝਿਆ ਕਰਤਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੀਤੇ ਲਪਟਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"hoi siaanaa samajhiaa karataa chhadd keete lapaTaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When grown up, he (man) leaving aside the creator Lord becomes engrossed with His creation."}}},{"verse_id":202941,"page_no":15,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੨੮॥","translit_en":"gur poore vin mohiaa maiaa ||28||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the perfect Guru, man goes on to be engrossed into the web of maya."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40353,"next":40355}}

men (to meet his selfish ends)."}}},{"verse_id":202945,"page_no":15,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਪਸੂ ਨ ਮੰਗੈ ਪਸੂ ਤੇ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਘੇਰੇ।","translit_en":"pasoo na ma(n)gai pasoo te pa(n)kheroo pa(n)kheroo ghere|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"An animal from animals and a bird from birds never ask for anything."}}},{"verse_id":202946,"page_no":15,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਲਖ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਤਮ ਮਾਣਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਭਲੇਰੇ।","translit_en":"chauraaseeh lakh joon vich utam maanas joon bhalere|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Among eighty-four lakh species of life, the human life is the best one."}}},{"verse_id":202947,"page_no":15,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਉਤਮ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਲਖ ਫੇਰੇ।","translit_en":"autam man bach karam kar janam maran bhavajal lakh fere|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Having even the best mind, speech and actions, man goes on transmigtraing in the ocean of life and death."}}},{"verse_id":202948,"page_no":15,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਭਲੇ ਭਲੇਰੇ।","translit_en":"raajaa parajaa hoi kai sukh vich dhukh hoi bhale bhalere|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whether it is a king or the people, even the good persons suffer the fear (of going away) from pleasure."}}},{"verse_id":202949,"page_no":15,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਤਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਹਾਲੀਐ ਚਕੀ ਚਟਣ ਜਾਇ ਅਨ੍ਹੇਰੇ।","translit_en":"kutaa raaj bahaaleeaai chakee chaTan jai anhere|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Dog, even if enthroned, according to its basic nature goes on to lick the flourmill at the fall of darkness."}}},{"verse_id":202950,"page_no":15,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗਰਭ ਵਸੇਰੇ ॥੧੯॥","translit_en":"gur poore vin garabh vasere ||19||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without the perfect Guru one has to stay in the abode of womb i.e. the transmigration never ends."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40354,"next":40356}}

ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਹੋਈ।","translit_en":"van van vaas vanaasapat cha(n)dhan baajh na cha(n)dhan hoiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The forests are replete with vegetation but without dhaat paaras baajh na ka(n)chan soiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Minerals are there on all the mountain but without the philosopher's stone they do not transform into gold."}}},{"verse_id":202954,"page_no":15,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਣਿ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਕੋਈ।","translit_en":"chaar varan chhia dharasanaa saadhasa(n)gat vin saadh na saints."}}},{"verse_id":202955,"page_no":15,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਣੋਈ।","translit_en":"gur upadhes aves kar gurmukh saadhasa(n)gat saints."}}},{"verse_id":202956,"page_no":15,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਪਿਉ ਪਿਓਈ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv leen hoi piram piaalaa apiau pioiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Then, they getting the consciousness attuned to the Word, quaff the cup of nectar of loving devotion."}}},{"verse_id":202957,"page_no":15,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨਿ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਦੁਬਲੇ ਦੇਹ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਥੋਈ।","translit_en":"man unaman tan dhubale dheh bidheh saneh sathoiee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The mind now reaching the highest stage of spiritual realisation (turiya) and becoming subtle stabilises in the love of the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":202958,"page_no":15,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਲਖ ਲਖੋਈ ॥੨੦॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakhoiee ||20||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gurmukhs beholding the invisible Lord receive the fruits of that pleasure."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40355,"next":40357}}
files.shabads/80/40357.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40357,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":15,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":202959,"last_verse_id":202966,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":202959,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੨੧ : ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚ ਉਦਾਸ","translit_en":"pauRee 21 : maiaa vich udhaas","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Indifferent to maya"}}},{"verse_id":202960,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰਨਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g maiaa a(n)dhar karan udhaasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gumukhs get pleasure in the company of saints. They remain indifferent to maya though they live in it."}}},{"verse_id":202961,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਵਲੁ ਹੈ ਸੂਰਜ ਧ੍ਯਾਨੁ ਅਗਾਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"jiau jal a(n)dhar kaval hai sooraj dhayaan agaas nivaasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As a lotus, which remains in water and yet keep its gaze fixed towards the sun, gurmukhs always keep their consciousness attuned to the Lord."}}},{"verse_id":202962,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨੁ ਸਪੀਂ ਵੇੜਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan sapee(n) veRiaa seetal saa(n)t suga(n)dh vigaasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sandalwood remains entwined by snakes but still it spreads cool and peace-producing fragrance all around."}}},{"verse_id":202963,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat sa(n)saar vich sabadh surat liv sahaj equipoise."}}},{"verse_id":202964,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਭੋਗ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਅਛਲ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"jog jugat bhog bhugat jin jeevan mukat achhal abinaasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They conquering the technique of yoga and bhog (enjoyment) become liberated in life, undecievable and indestructible."}}},{"verse_id":202965,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ।","translit_en":"paarabraham pooran braham gur paramesar aas niraasee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the transcendetal Brahm is the perfect Brahm , the same way the Guru who is indifferent to hopes and desires is also nothing but God."}}},{"verse_id":202966,"page_no":15,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ ॥੨੧ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"akath kathaa abigat paragaasee ||21 ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"(Through the Guru) that ineffable story and unmenifest light of the Lord becomes known (to the world)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40356,"next":40358}}

ones."}}},{"verse_id":202991,"page_no":16,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh vasa(n)dhaa ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the files.shabads/80/40362.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40362,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":16,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":203000,"last_verse_id":203007,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203000,"page_no":16,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਲਾਹ ਰੂਪ ਹਨ","translit_en":"pauRee 5 : satiguroo malaeh roop han","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"True Guru is the boatman"}}},{"verse_id":203001,"page_no":16,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਗਰ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੁਹਾਣਾ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ।","translit_en":"saagar a(n)dhar bohithaa vich muhaanaa paraupakaaree|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The vessel is in the ocean and there is a benevolent sailor in it."}}},{"verse_id":203002,"page_no":16,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਭਾਰ ਅਥਰਬਣ ਲਦੀਐ ਲੈ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਨਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ।","translit_en":"bhaar atharaban ladheeaai lai vaapaar chaRhan vaapaaree|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The vessel is amply loaded and the traders get boarded thereon."}}},{"verse_id":203003,"page_no":16,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਇਰ ਲਹਰ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਅਤਿ ਅਸਗਾਹ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਪਾਰੀ।","translit_en":"sair lahar na viaapiee at asagaeh athaeh apaaree|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Waves of impassable ocean put no impact upon any one."}}},{"verse_id":203004,"page_no":16,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਬਹਲੇ ਪੂਰ ਲੰਘਾਇਦਾ ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ।","translit_en":"bahale poor la(n)ghaidhaa sahee salaamat paar utaaree|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That boatman takes the passengers across safe, dale and hearty. ੯ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਪਾਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਹੈ","translit_en":"pauRee 9 : gurmukh paaras roop hai","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gurmukh is philosopher's stone"}}},{"verse_id":203033,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਥਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਲੁਕਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ।","translit_en":"paaras pathar aakheeaai lukiaa rahai na aap janaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Philosopher's stone remains hidden and does not publicise itself."}}},{"verse_id":203034,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ਸਿਞਾਣਦਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ।","translit_en":"viralaa koi sin(j)aanadhaa khojee khoj le so paae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Any rare one identifies it and only a prospector gets it."}}},{"verse_id":203035,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ।","translit_en":"paaras paras aparas hoi asaT dhaat ik dhaat karaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Touching that stone, the lowly metals transform into one metal, gold."}}},{"verse_id":203036,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਬਾਰਹ ਵੰਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਵਿਕਾਏ।","translit_en":"baareh va(n)nee hoi kai ka(n)chan mul amul vikaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becoming pure gold those metals are sold as invaluable ones."}}},{"verse_id":203037,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g sabadh surat liv aghaR ghaRaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation where merging consciousness into Word, the clumsy mind is chiselled into beautiful shape."}}},{"verse_id":203038,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਚਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਭਾਏ।","translit_en":"charan saran liv leen hoi sai(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree bhaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even a worldly person here, concentrating upon the feet of Guru, becomes dear to God, the formless One."}}},{"verse_id":203039,"page_no":16,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੯॥","translit_en":"ghar baaree hoi nij ghar jaae ||9||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Becoming householder, man resides in his innate nature (atman)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40365,"next":40367}}

{"shabad":{"shabad_id":40367,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":16,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":203040,"last_verse_id":203047,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji
