੧੦ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚੇ ਹਨ","translit_en":"pauRee 10 : gurmukh sabh to(n) u'che han","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gurmukhs are the highest ones"}}},{"verse_id":203041,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹਰੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਕਾਮਨਾਂ ਪੁਜਾਏ।","translit_en":"chi(n)taaman chi(n)taa harai kaamadhen kaamanaa(n) pujaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Chintamani alleviates anxieties and wish-fulfilling cow (kamadhena) fulfils all desires."}}},{"verse_id":203042,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਫਲ ਫੁਲਿ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਪਾਰਜਾਤੁ ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਾਥ ਲੁਭਾਏ।","translit_en":"fal ful dhe(n)dhaa paarajaat ridh sidh nav naath lubhaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Parijat tree gives flowers and fruits and the nine naths are engrossed with the miraculous powers."}}},{"verse_id":203043,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਅਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਰਖਾਰਥ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਂਵ ਗਣਾਏ।","translit_en":"dhas avataar akaar kar purakhaarath kar naa(n)v ganaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ten incarnations (of Hindu mythology) assumed human body and showed their valour to spread their names."}}},{"verse_id":203044,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g chaar padhaarath sevaa laae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The pleasure fruit of the gurmukhs is the holy congregation wherein all the four ideals of life (dharma, arth, kam and moks) serve themselves."}}},{"verse_id":203045,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਕਥੀ ਨ ਜਾਏ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv piram ras akath kahaanee kathee na jaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The consciousness of gurmukhs there remains merged in the Word and the story of their love is ineffable."}}},{"verse_id":203046,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਹੁਇ ਅਛਲ ਛਲਾਏੇ।","translit_en":"paarabraham pooran braham bhagat vachhal hui achhal chhalaaee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The transcendental Brahm is the perfect Brahm who by becoming affectionate to devotees puts many deceitful persons in the web of deception."}}},{"verse_id":203047,"page_no":16,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧੦॥","translit_en":"lekh alekh na keemat paae ||10||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is free from all accounts and none can understand His mystery."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40366,"next":40368}}
files.shabads/80/40368.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40368,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":16,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":10,"first_verse_id":203048,"last_verse_id":203057,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203048,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੧ : ਕਾਦਰ ਦਾ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ","translit_en":"pauRee 11 : kaadhar dhaa piram piaalaa","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Creator's cup of love  "}}},{"verse_id":203049,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਿ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"eik kavaau pasaau kar nira(n)kaar aakaar banaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With a single Word that formless Lord created the whole world."}}},{"verse_id":203050,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਤੋਲਿ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਨਾ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰਿ ਤੋਲਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"tol atol naa toleeaai tul na tulaadhaar tolaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Extension of the Lord (this world) can in no way be measured."}}},{"verse_id":203051,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਿਖੀਐ ਅੰਗੁ ਨ ਅਖਰੁ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"lekh alekh na likheeaai a(n)g na akhar lekh likhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By no account this world can be understood because all numerals and letters come to an end for this."}}},{"verse_id":203052,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲੁ ਨ ਮੋਲੀਐ ਲਖੁ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"mul amul na moleeaai lakh padhaarath lavai na laiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Myriad kinds of its materials are invaluable; their price cannot be fixed."}}},{"verse_id":203053,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਬੋਲਿ ਅਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਬੋਲੀਐ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"bol abol na boleeaai sun sun aakhan aakh sunaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even through speech, nothing can be said and heard about it."}}},{"verse_id":203054,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਅਗਮੁ ਅਥਾਹੁ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"agam athaahu agaadh bodh a(n)t na paaraavaar na paiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"This world in unapproachable, unfathomable and full of mystery; its mystique cannot be understood."}}},{"verse_id":203055,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕਾਦਰੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ।","translit_en":"kudharat keem na jaaneeaai kevadd kaadhar kit ghar aaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When it is impossible to understand the creation, how could its Creator's greatness and His residence be known?"}}},{"verse_id":203056,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਲਖ ਲਖਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukhafal saadhasa(n)g sabadh surat liv alakh lakhaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation where by merging the consciousness in the Word that invisible Lord is visualised."}}},{"verse_id":203057,"page_no":16,"line_no":11,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਾਇਆ ॥੧੧॥","translit_en":"piram piaalaa ajar jaraiaa ||11||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the holy congregation, the unbreakable cup of love is drunk by becoming tolerant."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40367,"next":40369}}
files.shabads/80/40369.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40369,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":16,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":203058,"last_verse_id":203065,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203058,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੨ : ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੱਚ-ਖੰਡ","translit_en":"pauRee 12 : saadhasa(n)gat sa'cha-kha(n)dd","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Holy Congregation, the abode of truth  "}}},{"verse_id":203059,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਦਹੁ ਸਬਦਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਕਿਉਂ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਜਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"saadhahu sabadhahu baaharaa akath kathaa kiau(n) jihabaa jaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Lord is beyond taste and words; how can His ineffable story be told by tongue?"}}},{"verse_id":203060,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕਥਨੀ ਬਦਨੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ।","translit_en":"ausatat ni(n)dhaa baaharaa kathanee badhanee vich na aanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He being beyond praise and slander does not come in the periphery of telling and hearing."}}},{"verse_id":203061,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਗੰਧ ਸਪਰਸੁ ਅਗੋਚਰਾ ਨਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"ga(n)dh saparas agocharaa naas saas herat hairaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is beyond smell and touch and the nose, and the breath is also wonder-struck but cannot know Him."}}},{"verse_id":203062,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਵਰਨਹੁ ਚਿਹਨਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਅਦਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"varanahu chihanahu baaharaa dhisaT adhisaT na dhiaan dhin(g)aanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is away from any varna and symbolism and is even beyond the sight of concentration."}}},{"verse_id":203063,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਨਿਰਾਲੰਬੁ ਅਵਲੰਬ ਵਿਣੁ ਧਰਤਿ ਅਗਾਸਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"niraala(n)b avala(n)b vin dharat agaas nivaas viddaanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Without any prop He resides in the grandeur of earth and sky."}}},{"verse_id":203064,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡਿ ਹੈ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd hai nira(n)kaar gur sabadh sin(j)aanai|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Holy congregation is the abode of truth where through the word of the Guru, the formless Lord is recognised."}}},{"verse_id":203065,"page_no":16,"line_no":12,"gurmukhi":"ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਾਦਰ ਨੋ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ॥੧੨॥","translit_en":"kudharat kaadhar no kurabaanai ||12||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whole of this creation is sacrifice unto the creator."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40368,"next":40370}}
files.shabads/80/40370.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40370,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":16,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":203066,"last_verse_id":203073,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203066,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੱਚਾ ਰਸਤਾ","translit_en":"pauRee 13 : gurmukhaa(n) dhaa sa'chaa rasataa","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The true way of gurmukhs"}}},{"verse_id":203067,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੀਨੁ ਚਲੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"gurmukh pa(n)th aga(n)m hai jiau jal a(n)dhar meen chala(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the path of fish in water is unknowable, the way of gurmukhs is also unapproachable."}}},{"verse_id":203068,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਪੰਖੀ ਆਗਾਸ ਉਡੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"gurmukh khoj alakh hai jiau pa(n)khee aagaas udda(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the path of birds flying in the sky cannot be known, the thoughtful and search-orientated way of gurmukh is also imperceptible. It cannot be understood."}}},{"verse_id":203069,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਚੰਦਉਰੀ ਨਗਰੁ ਵਸੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat raharaas hai har cha(n)dhauree nagar vasa(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Holy congregation is the straight path for gurmukhs and this world is full of illusions for them."}}},{"verse_id":203070,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਤੰਬੋਲ ਰਸੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲੈ ਰੰਗੁ ਚਰੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"chaar varan ta(n)bol ras piram piaalai ra(n)g chara(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the four colours of betel catechu, betelnut, lime and betel lead become one (red) colour (of joy-giving love), the gurmukhs also enjoy the cup of the Lord's love."}}},{"verse_id":203071,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਕਰੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"sabadh surat liv leen hoi cha(n)dhan vaas nivaas kara(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"As the fragrance of sandal comes to reside in other plants, they merging their consciousness into Word reside in the hearts of others."}}},{"verse_id":203072,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਣੁ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕੂੰਜਿ ਕੂਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਵੰਸ ਵਧੰਦਾ।","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan simaran jugat koo(n)j kooram ha(n)s va(n)s vadha(n)dhaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By means of knowledge, meditation and remembrance, they like cranes, tortoise and swans expand their family or tradition."}}},{"verse_id":203073,"page_no":16,"line_no":13,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਅਲਖ ਲਖੰਦਾ ॥੧੩॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal alakh lakha(n)dhaa ||13||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukhs come face to face with God, the pleasure of all fruits."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40369,"next":40371}}

"}}},{"verse_id":203161,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਤੀਰਥਿ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲੋਗ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਇ ਜੁੜੰਦੇ।","translit_en":"teerath purab sa(n)jog log chahu ku(n)ddaa(n) dhe aai juRa(n)dhe|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"On pilgrimage centres, because of the anniversary festivals, millions of people get together from all the four directions."}}},{"verse_id":203162,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਛਿਅ ਦਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰੰਦੇ।","translit_en":"chaar varan chhia dharasanaa naam dhaan isanaan kara(n)dhe|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The followers of six philosophies and the four varnas make recitations, charities and take ablutions there."}}},{"verse_id":203163,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ।","translit_en":"jap tap sa(n)jam hom jag varat nem kar vedh suna(n)dhe|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Performing recitations, offering burnt offerings, fast and undertaking rigorous disciples, they listen to the recitals from the vedas."}}},{"verse_id":203164,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਥਾਨ ਪੁਜੰਦੇ।","translit_en":"giaan dhiaan simaran jugat dhevee dhev sathaan puja(n)dhe|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meditating, they adopt they techniques of recitations."}}},{"verse_id":203165,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਬਗਾ ਬਗੇ ਕਪੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਪਰਾਧਿ ਨਿਵੰਦੇ।","translit_en":"bagaa bage kapaRe kar samaadh aparaadh niva(n)dhe|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Worship of gods and goddesses is performed at their respective abodes - temples."}}},{"verse_id":203166,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਨ ਚਾਲ ਚਲੰਦੇ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun gurmukh pa(n)th na chaal chala(n)dhe|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"White-clad persons remain engaged in trance but like a crane as and when they get opportunity they immediately stoop to commit crime."}}},{"verse_id":203167,"page_no":17,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਫਲੁ ਨ ਲਹੰਦੇ ॥੩॥","translit_en":"kapaT sanehee fal na laha(n)dhe ||3||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Listening to the word of the Guru in the holy congregation, the fake lovers who do not adopt it in their life, do not attain any fruit (in their life)."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40380,"next":40382}}
files.shabads/80/40382.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40382,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":17,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":203168,"last_verse_id":203175,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203168,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"੪ : ਅਨ-ਅਧਿਕਾਰੀ","translit_en":"4 : ana-adhikaaree","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even listening to the Word of the Guru, the undeserving person attains no peace-"}}},{"verse_id":203169,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਵਣਿ ਵਣ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੇ ਵੁਠੈ ਸੁਕੈ ਅਕੁ ਜਵਾਹਾ।","translit_en":"saavan van hareeaavale vuThai sukai ak javaahaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the month of Savan, the whole forest becomes green but akk, a wild plant of sandy region ( Calatropis procera) and javah (a prickly plant used in medicine) go dry."}}},{"verse_id":203170,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਬਬੀਹੇ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਸਿਪ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੋਤੀ ਓਮਾਹਾ।","translit_en":"tirapat babeehe savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh sip a(n)dhar motee omaahaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Getting rain drops in the savanti nakstr (a special formation of stars in the sky) the rain bird (Paphia) gets satisfied and if the same drop falls in the mouth of a shell, it is transformed into a pearl."}}},{"verse_id":203171,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਕਦਲੀ ਵਣਹੁ ਕਪੂਰ ਹੋਇ ਕਲਰਿ ਕਵਲ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਸਮਾਹਾ।","translit_en":"kadhalee vanahu kapoor hoi kalar kaval na hoi samaahaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"In the banana fields, the same drop becomes camphor but on alkaline earth and lotus hat drop has no impact."}}},{"verse_id":203172,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਬਿਸੀਅਰ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਹੋਇ ਧਾਤ ਸੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਪਾਤ੍ਰ ਦੁਰਾਹਾ।","translit_en":"biseear muh kaalakooT hoi dhaat supaatr kupaatr dhuraahaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That drop, if it goes into the mouth of a snake, becomes deadly poison. Therefore, a thing given to a genuine and undeserving person has different effects."}}},{"verse_id":203173,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਉਭੈ ਸਾਹਾ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun saa(n)t na aavai ubhai saahaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Likewise, those who are engrossed in the worldly delusions do not get peace even though they listen to the word of the Guru in the holy congregation."}}},{"verse_id":203174,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮਰਸੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬਦਰਾਹੀ ਬਦਰਾਹਾ।","translit_en":"gurmukh sukh fal piramaras manmukh badharaahee badharaahaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The gurmukh attains the pleasure fruit of the love of the Lord, but manmukh, the mind orientated one, goes on following the evil path."}}},{"verse_id":203175,"page_no":17,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਮਨਮੁਖ ਟੋਟਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਲਾਹਾ ॥੪॥","translit_en":"manmukh ToTaa gurmukh laahaa ||4||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Manmukh always suffers loss whereas the Gurmukh earns profit."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40381,"next":40383}}

cotton tree is of big expanse and fruitless chil tree touches the sky (these both like an egotist's person are proud of their size)."}}},{"verse_id":203180,"page_no":17,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜਲਦਾ ਵਾਂਸੁ ਵਢਾਈਐ ਵੰਝੁਲੀਆਂ ਵਜਨਿ ਬੇਬਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"jaladhaa vaa(n)s vaddaieeaai va(n)jhuleeaa(n) vajan bebaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bamboo keeps scorching thinking of its greatness."}}},{"verse_id":203181,"page_no":17,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਗੰਧ ਰਵਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat vaas rahai niraga(n)dh ravaanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Sandal makes the whole vegetation fragrant but bamboo remains devoid of fragrance."}}},{"verse_id":203182,"page_no":17,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸੈ ਅਭਾਗ ਪਰਾਣੀ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat gur sabadh sun ridhai na vasai abhaag paraanee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who even listening to the word of Guru in the holy congregation do not adopt it in the heart are unfortunate."}}},{"verse_id":203183,"page_no":17,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥੫॥","translit_en":"haumai a(n)dhar bharam bhulaanee ||5||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They engrossed in ego and delusions go astray."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40382,"next":40384}}
files.shabads/80/40384.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40384,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":17,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":203184,"last_verse_id":203191,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203184,"page_no":17,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"੬ : ਉੱਲੂ ਤੋਂ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼-ਮਨਮੁਖ","translit_en":"6 : u'loo to(n) upadhesha-manmukh","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Lesson from owl-Manmukh  -"}}},{"verse_id":203185,"page_no":17,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰਜੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਦੋਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਕਰੈ ਅਨੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਏ।","translit_en":"sooraj jot udhot kar chaanan karai aner gavaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The sun with its bright rays dispels darkness and scatters light all around."}}},{"verse_id":203186,"page_no":17,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਰਤਿ ਵਿਰਤਿ ਜਗ ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਸਭ ਸਨਬੰਧਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ।","translit_en":"kirat virat jag varatamaan sabh sanaba(n)dhan mukat karaae|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Seeing it the whole world gets engaged in business. files.shabads/80/40404.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40404,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":18,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":203346,"last_verse_id":203352,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203346,"page_no":18,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"੫ : ਕੁਦਰਤ ਭੈ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ","translit_en":"5 : kudharat bhai vich hai","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Creation is in fear   "}}},{"verse_id":203347,"page_no":18,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਆਗਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਧਾਰ ਭੈ ਭਾਰ ਧਰਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"bhai vich dharat aagaas hai niraadhaar bhai bhaar dharaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Earth and sky are in fear but not held by any support, and, that Lord sustains them under the weight of fears."}}},{"verse_id":203348,"page_no":18,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੋ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਖੈ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।","translit_en":"paun paanee baisa(n)taro bhai vich rakhai mel milaiaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Keeping air, water and fire in fear (discipline). files.shabads/80/40409.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":40409,"source_id":"B","writer_id":22,"raag_id":0,"page_no":18,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":7,"first_verse_id":203381,"last_verse_id":203387,"source_english":"Bhai Gurdas Ji Vaaran","source_unicode":"ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਵਾਰਾਂ","writer":"Bhai Gurdaas Ji","writer_unicode":null,"raag":null,"raag_unicode":null},"verses":[{"verse_id":203381,"page_no":18,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"੧੦ : ਕਾਦਰ ਨਿਰਲੇਪ ਤੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੈ","translit_en":"10 : kaadhar niralep te pooran hai","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The Creator is detached and perfect    "}}},{"verse_id":203382,"page_no":18,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਿਰਠਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਰੰਗ ਬਿਰੰਗੀ।","translit_en":"paravadhagaar salaaheeaai siraTh upaiee ra(n)g bira(n)gee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"That sustainer Lord ought to be praised who has created the multicoloured creation."}}},{"verse_id":203383,"page_no":18,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਜਿਕੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸਬਾਹਿਦਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਅਣਮੰਗੀ।","translit_en":"raajik rijak sabaahidhaa sabhanaa dhaat kare anama(n)gee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He is bestower of livelihood to everyone and giver of charity unasked for."}}},{"verse_id":203384,"page_no":18,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਕਿਸੈ ਜਿਵੇਹਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਮੰਦੀ ਚੰਗੀ।","translit_en":"kisai jivehaa naeh ko dhubidhaa a(n)dhar ma(n)dhee cha(n)gee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"None resembles anyone and the jiva (creative) is good or bad according to the ratio of perplexity in him."}}},{"verse_id":203385,"page_no":18,"line_no":10,"gurmukhi":"ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਲੰਗੀ।","translit_en":"paarabraham niralep hai pooran braham sadhaa sahala(n)gee|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Being transcendent, He is detached from every thing and being perfect Brahm. "}}},{"verse_id":203426,"page_no":18,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਣਾ।","translit_en":"saadhasa(n)gat kar saadhanaa piram piaalaa ajar ਕਰਣ ਨ ਕਾਰਣ ਕਰਣਾ।","translit_en":"karan kaaran samarath hoi kaaran karan na kaaran karanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Now he is already cause of all the causes but still does nothing harmful to delight."}}},{"verse_id":203463,"page_no":18,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚੀ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"sachee sifat salaeh sach sach salaahan a(n)mirat velaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone."}}},{"verse_id":203464,"page_no":18,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਸਚਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਨ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"sachaa gurmukh pa(n)th hai sach upadhes na garab gahelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"There, in the early morning eulogisation is true and is of the truth alone."}}},{"verse_id":203465,"page_no":18,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਆਸਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਗਤਿ ਸਚਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਮੇਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਖੇਲਾ।","translit_en":"aasaa vich niraas gat sachaa khel mel sach khelaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Gurmukhs remain detached among many hopes and they always play the game of truth."}}},{"verse_id":203466,"page_no":18,"line_no":20,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ॥੨੦॥","translit_en":"gurmukh sikh guroo gur chelaa ||20||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such gurmukhs become Guru and the Guru becomes their disciple."}}}],"nav":{"prev":40418,"next":40420}}

kurabaanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He remains elated in the love of the Lord and goes sacrificed unto the feats of the creator."}}},{"verse_id":203474,"page_no":18,"line_no":21,"gurmukhi":"ਲੇਪ lahanaa|","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One should remain true in faith and contentment; the transaction of thankfulness should be kept to continue and one should remain away from worldly give and take."}}},{"verse_id":203482,"page_no":18,"line_no":22,"gurmukhi":"ਨੀਰਿ ਨ ਡੁਬਣੁ ਅਗਿ ਨ ਦਹਣਾ ॥੨੨॥","translit_en":"neer na dduban ag na dhahanaa ||22||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Such a person neither
